# Scope: the reader whose mind a work changed ($SOURCE$, a flag): it counts
# toward the work's Authoritative gate (kehillah_minds_count_effect).
kehillah_minds_count_dispatch_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_sefer_yetzirah }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_yetzirah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_hekhalot_rabbati }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_shiur_qomah }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_shiur_qomah }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_sefer_harazim }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_sefer_harazim }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_emunot_vedeot }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_emunot_vedeot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_chovot_halevavot }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_chovot_halevavot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_kuzari }
		kehillah_minds_count_effect = { KEY = work_kuzari }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $SOURCE$ ?= flag:work_mekor_hayyim }
